svg.title: FleetPermit end to end: one lease from request to expiry
svg.desc: Animated walkthrough in ten steps, repeating. 1. sre-agent has a SPIFFE identity from Kubernetes Pod Certificates. 2. An engineer creates ToolAccessLease incident-42: restart_workload, 10 min. 3. FleetPermit checks WHO, WHAT and HOW LONG. All three pass. 4. Then WHERE: the Placement picks env=production: east and west, not edge. 5. It renders an XAccessPolicy with a CEL time bound, sent by ManifestWork. 6. sre-agent calls restart_workload on cluster-east through Envoy: ALLOW. 7. cluster-edge has no grant: DENY. The policy does not permit read_secret: DENY. 8. Ten minutes pass, sped up. The lease reaches its expiry, 10:15:00Z. 9. Envoy itself denies: request.time is past expiry, even with the hub down. 10. FleetPermit marks the lease Expired and withdraws the grant. The hub holds the FleetAccessPolicy, the ToolAccessLease, the Placement and fleetpermit-controller; each managed cluster has an Envoy gateway, an XAccessPolicy and an MCP tool server.
